title: Nepal Flood Live: Nepal Finance Minister says at least $4 bn needed to rebuild country after floods
description: Nepal Flash Flood Live Updates: The death toll from the catastrophic flash flood that devastated several parts of Nepal earlier this week has risen to at least 475. Meanwhile, in Tibet, according to Chinese state media, at least three people died and 558, including 260 foreigners, were missing. Both Nepal and China have warned of fresh risks of flooding in the Himalayas as two lakes that have developed on either side of their border threaten to burst in the area most severely impacted by the natural calamity. Search and rescue operations are still underway in the debris-strewn valleys and hillsides of Nepal, with nearly 1,000 people still missing. The deadly flash flood originated in the Bhotekoshi River. Follow indiatoday.in for all the latest updates on the Nepal flood.
